name: claude-mods

plugins.name: deadlines
plugins.description: Live deadline countdowns in the Claude Code status line. /ddl to list, add, remove.

plugins.name: usage-bar
plugins.description: Usage bars (context, 5h, 7d, cost) above the prompt plus an auto-compact nudge. Toggle with /usage-bar.

plugins.name: context-bar
plugins.description: Stacked context-window bar above the prompt, colored like /context. Toggle with /context-bar.

plugins.name: monitor
plugins.description: A control room above the prompt: background agents and shells (running, done, failed), blocked tool calls and context usage. /monitor pins it.

description: Claude Code mods by Richard Suwandi: deadline countdowns, usage and context bars, and a background-job monitor.
